name: Save the Gibbon Grant

funder.name: IUCN SSC Primate Specialist Group, Section on Small Apes

summary: Ongoing grant for projects in South East Asia working with gibbons, covering applied conservation, conservation-linked research and education, with a focus on urgent threats.

status.quote: The grant is available on an ongoing basis. Please email us for an initial discussion - we're always happy to hear from applicants.

geography.quote: This grant is to support applied conservation, conservation-related research and education efforts of projects working with gibbons in South East Asia.
